material.witness_plan: Separate-session witness re-parses the CI logs for all recent pages runs, tabulates sizes and load technique, and confirms the wasm digest matches the committed build

note: Mechanism identified: per-file transfer sizes are stable within a run (gzip bodies cached once at level 6 in first-draw.mjs); the 2409490/2889942/1926628 spread across CI runs is per-sha wasm builds, not a flaky transfer. Build-vs-live hash comparison of the compare job printed match. AGENTS.md records the finding (close commit 4f7d001064116144552684dd337bb96d400e0493), which also corrects the stale CI median claim to the measured 8.7-9.8 s.
